v1.2.3: The appointment time is now chosen with two wheels (hours and minutes) and a large readout: simpler and less scattered. Windows and menus close smoothly. DoctorWood keeps its own sync port, so it never clashes with DoctorCar or BothWise.
v1.2.2: Date and time pickers in the app style, like DoctorCar: they open from the bottom, you choose and confirm; tapping the month lets you pick the year.
v1.2.1: Notifications now appear at the bottom of the screen and close with a swipe; smoother Settings sections on less powerful phones.
v1.2.0: DoctorWood now speaks English: Settings → Appearance → Language. PDFs, the camera and the fingerprint prompts follow the chosen language too.
v1.1.1: Settings like the other CrsLabs apps: the same Appearance (theme, animations, text size, screen smoothness) and Updates sections; the same light background.
v1.1.0: First public version: automatic updates from GitHub (on the workshop tablet too), «workshop only» tablet, new user guide and tutorials.
